newsitem.title: USA: Cross Timbers sees results improving.
newsitem.headline: Cross Timbers sees results improving.

text.p: Cross Timbers Oil Co said on Thursday it expected its results to improve throughout the remainder of 1996, and the company was on track to increase cash flow to $5.50 per share in 1997.

The company reported third quarter 1996 earnings of $0.26 per share versus $0.10 per share in the same period last year. Cash flow from operations before changes in working capital was $0.95 per share, up from $0.56 per share in the third quarter 1995.

"We are pleased with the third quarter results," said Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Bob Simpson. "We continue to see the impact of our recent acquisitions with our aggressive development program."
